fact: The INE's Estatísticas do Comércio Externo - Resumo anual 2025 (published February 2026) states its base data come from the Direção Geral das Alfândegas (DGA) as electronic files resulting from the use of customs administrative acts (Sidónia ++), with monthly extractions, and that this is a partnership of some decades; it follows the 2024 edition.
title: Estatísticas do Comércio Externo - Resumo anual 2025
